<autocedar_condition_packet id="condition.0002.step0001">
Requirement to encode:
[source_id: src.root.p0002.l3; section: root] A user may read a document only when that user is the document's owner.

Write one condition atom for each scope below. AutoCedar joins the conditions of a slice with AND and the slices of a scope with OR, so encode only what this requirement says.

Scope scope.readDocument.User.Document: principal User, action readDocument, resource Document (every way to allow it is listed).
  It is a condition of slice slice.readDocument.User.Document.1: User may read a document only when the user is the document's owner.
  The other conditions of this slice (encoded separately):
    - none
  Approved condition atoms of this scope:
    - none yet

Rules for interpretation (apply them to every requirement):
  [source_id: src.root.p0003.l3; section: root] These are the only permissions.
  [source_id: src.root.p0004.l3; section: root] All other actions, including deleting a document, are denied.
</autocedar_condition_packet>
